en: Vintage postcard showing a narrow, bustling street lined with traditional overhanging wooden mashrabiya balconies and shops. In the distance a mosque minaret rises above the buildings. The caption printed below the image reads "Le Caire Souk ez Zilhat." The lower part of the card contains handwritten French text and a signature, including the words "Le Caire 11/24 Avril 190..." and a stamp mark.
